decision: Route uncertain cases while preserving a defensible error guarantee for the deployed policy.
primary_outcome: Accepted-decision error risk under the frozen routing policy, jointly reported with acceptance coverage and review burden.
denominator: All eligible routed cases for coverage; accepted cases with the required valid labels for risk certification.
independence_unit: Independent source case; repeated observations and shared-source cases require dependence-aware design.
quality_guardrail: Known routing/retention mechanism, adequate calibration support and simultaneous threshold control.
minimum_data: Case IDs, fixed routing policy, inclusion/retention probabilities, retained Bernoulli outcomes, labels, thresholds and calibration split.
failure_handling: Unknown or outcome-dependent retention invalidates the claimed guarantee. Do not substitute weighted pseudo-counts for actual retained trials.
release_rule: Use certification only under the stated known-policy assumptions. Weighted Kish bounds remain heuristic; otherwise return inconclusive.
reversal: Routing changes, probabilities become unknown, or shifted cases lack calibration support.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: Why not use effective sample size as a certificate?
A Kish effective size summarizes weighting. By itself it does not make weighted outcomes an exact binomial experiment.
A risk bound can rule out automation even when average accuracy looks good, sending those cases to review.
